    for s2, p2, o2 in g.triples((s, uni.isTaughtIn, None)):
        print(f"  {s} -> {o2}")

print("\n=== ALL ENROLLMENTS ===")

from rdflib import Graph, Namespace, URIRef, Literal
from rdflib.namespace import RDF, XSD

g = Graph()
g.parse("/app/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")
uni = Namespace("http://university.org/ontology/")

# Compute per-department current enrollment counts
# Reference date: 2025-08-16
ref_date = Literal("2025-08-16", datatype=XSD.date)

# Get all departments
departments = list(g.subjects(RDF.type, uni.Department))
print(f"Total departments: {len(departments)}")

# For each department, count distinct currently-enrolled students
for dept in sorted(departments, key=str):
    # Get courses taught in this department
    courses = list(g.objects(dept, None))  # wrong direction
    # Actually: course -> isTaughtIn -> dept
    courses = [c for c in g.subjects(uni.isTaughtIn, dept)]
    
    # For each course, find students enrolled
    students = set()
    for course in courses:
        for student in g.subjects(uni.isEnrolledIn, course):
            # Check enrollment date
            for enroll_date in g.objects(student, uni.hasEnrollmentDate):
                if enroll_date <= ref_date:
                    # Check graduation date
                    grad_dates = list(g.objects(student, uni.hasGraduationDate))
                    if not grad_dates or any(gd > ref_date for gd in grad_dates):
                        students.add(student)
    
    dept_name = str(dept).split('/')[-1]
    print(f"  {dept_name}: {len(students)} currently enrolled students")
